meta.title: OpenCode session header
meta.description: Adds the x-opencode-session routing header to OpenCode gateway requests, so route shapes that drop pi-ai's own wrapper stop failing with 400 MissingSessionID. Every pi-ai inference request is covered through the llm-pi-ai/request-headers waterfall, and an optional fetch guard covers model discovery and other direct gateway traffic. The value is the current DSH session id when the request has one and a stable per-process id otherwise; set hosts, providers, a fixed session value, or the fetch guard in the plugin row.
